name: servicehub.config.schema

controller.description: Specifies the location of the controller executable and activation parameters.

contextEnvironmentVariables.description: Array of environment variable names. These variables are mixed-up into hash that determines the location service pipe name. The order is significant.

additionalEnvironmentVariables.description: An object with properties like "environment variable name": "value" that describes what environment variables to set for the Hub Controller.

^[A-Za-z0-9_/\\.]+$.description: The value of the environment variable to set.

rootDir.description: The path to the directory immediately under which are folders that contain *.servicehub.host.json files.
The path to the directory immediately under which are folders that contain *.servicehub.service.json files.

discoveryServices.description: Service names of optional discovery service modules. Controller will use them to locate a service which it cannot find in the services folder.

description:
Please find below the current ServiceHub configuration details. The controller is located at **C:\Program Files\ServiceHub\controller.exe** and will be launched with the arguments `--verbose`, `--port 8080`. For pipe name generation the controller will incorporate the environment variables **PATH** and **USERDOMAIN** in that order. In addition, two custom variables will be set for the controller process: **CUSTOM_SETTING** is set to `Enabled` and **API_KEY** is set to `12345-abcde`.

All host definition files are expected under the directory **C:/ServiceHub/hosts**, while the service definition files reside in **C:/ServiceHub/services**. If a requested service cannot be found locally, the controller will fall back to the discovery modules named **service-discovery** and **fallback-discovery**.
